2026 年企业 LLM Agent 平台选型

Executive Summary

RefractRouter v0.1 的平台选型在固定 DAG 执行约束下，LangGraph 作为底层执行基座与 DeepAgents 作为受约束的 harness 层构成最可辩护的组合 [source_001][source_002]。DeepAgents 提供规划、子代理、文件系统抽象与人机协同控制，但其自主规划与动态子代理生成在 v0.1 中被禁用 [source_001]。Pydantic AI 仅在结构化输出解析成为瓶颈时作为条件性增强引入 [source_003]。DeepSeek Harness 保留给外部验证环境，不进入核心路由循环 [source_004]。

Background

现有 LLM 路由研究大多为整个请求选择一个模型，而 RefractRouter 研究的是为任务 DAG 中每个节点分别选择模型能否改善质量-成本-延迟的帕累托前沿 [source_005]。静态任务分解属于应用层，路由器接收 DAG 作为输入并专注于逐节点模型选择，动态重分解推迟到节点级路由验证之后 [source_006]。这一研究定位决定了平台必须支持固定 DAG 的显式节点与边控制，而非动态规划能力。

Selection Criteria

v0.1 选型标准要求平台支持固定任务 DAG、逐节点模型选择、可复现运行记录与版本化提示词 [source_007][source_008]。基准测试需要固定 DAG、多个候选模型、逐节点与逐任务评分、成本核算和关键路径延迟，且首个基准应保持小规模以便复现 [source_007]。评分规则权重覆盖需求覆盖、证据准确性、分析深度、结构与可读性以及 HTML 有效性，评分提示词与规则版本必须随运行记录版本化 [source_008]。

Platform Comparison

DeepAgents 基于 LangGraph 构建，提供最丰富的 agent harness 特性，但其自主规划与动态子代理生成在 v0.1 中被禁用，大部分价值在固定 DAG 场景中未被使用 [source_001]。LangGraph 提供显式节点、边、持久状态与检查点，直接对齐固定任务 DAG 需求，是执行基座但缺少高层 agent 便利性 [source_002]。Pydantic AI 提供类型化工具定义与结构化输出，可提升逐节点模型选择结果的可靠性，但非核心依赖 [source_003]。DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 循环本身是插件，架构上有趣但保留给外部验证环境 [source_004]。

Risks

采用 DeepAgents 作为受约束 harness 层存在过度抽象风险，其高层特性可能掩盖逐节点控制与插桩需求，而 LangGraph 的显式节点与边更利于基准测试的逐节点评分与关键路径延迟测量 [source_001][source_002][source_007]。若结构化输出解析成为瓶颈而未引入 Pydantic AI，逐节点模型选择结果的可靠性可能下降 [source_003]。将 DSH 纳入核心循环会违反 v0.1 边界，破坏验证环境隔离 [source_004]。动态重分解若提前引入，会混淆应用层分解与路由层选择的职责边界 [source_006]。

Conclusion

LangGraph 作为执行基座配合 DeepAgents 作为受约束 harness 层，是 RefractRouter v0.1 最可辩护的平台选择 [source_001][source_002]。该组合在固定 DAG 约束下保留必要的逐节点控制与插桩能力，同时避免未使用的高层特性开销 [source_001][source_007]。Pydantic AI 保持条件性引入，DSH 留在外部验证环境 [source_003][source_004]。这一选择直接服务于逐节点模型选择这一核心研究问题，并支持可复现的基准运行记录 [source_005][source_008]。

References

本报告引用的来源包括 DeepAgents [source_001]、LangGraph [source_002]、Pydantic AI [source_003]、DeepSeek Harness [source_004]、LLM 路由研究缺口 [source_005]、任务分解边界 [source_006]、基准设计 [source_007] 与评分规则 [source_008]。所有来源的完整声明与内容哈希见 evidence 字段。

Source Trace

  • DeepAgents — DeepAgents is a LangChain harness built on LangGraph, providing planning, sub-agents, a filesystem abstraction, and human-in-the-loop controls; for RefractRouter v0.1 it is used as the fixed-DAG execution harness with autonomous planning and dynamic sub-agent generation disabled.
  • LangGraph — LangGraph is a graph state machine framework supporting explicit nodes, edges, durable state, and check-pointing, and RefractRouter uses it as the lower-level execution substrate for a fixed task DAG.
  • Pydantic AI — Pydantic AI provides typed tool definitions and structured model outputs, but RefractRouter v0.1 does not need it as a core dependency unless structured-output parsing becomes a bottleneck.
  • DeepSeek Harness — DeepSeek Harness (DSH) is an agent harness where the agent loop itself is a plugin, and for RefractRouter v0.1 DSH is reserved for the outer validation environment, not the core routing loop.
  • LLM routing research gap — Existing LLM routing work mostly selects one model for an entire request, while RefractRouter studies whether selecting a model separately for each node in a task DAG can improve the quality-cost-latency Pareto frontier.
  • Task decomposition boundary — Static task decomposition belongs to the application layer; the router receives the DAG as input and focuses on per-node model selection, with dynamic re-splitting deferred until node-level routing is validated.
  • Benchmark design — A useful routing benchmark needs fixed task DAGs, multiple candidate models, per-node and per-task scoring, cost accounting, and critical-path latency, and the first benchmark should stay small enough to reproduce.
  • Scoring rubric — The v0.1 scoring rubric weights requirement coverage, evidence accuracy, analysis depth, structure and readability, and HTML validity, and scoring prompts and rubric versions must be versioned with run records.

judge.rationale: Requirement coverage: All seven required sections (Executive Summary, Background, Selection Criteria, Platform Comparison, Risks, Conclusion, References) are present, plus a Source Trace section; all eight sources are used and referenced. Minor deduction because the References section is a prose list rather than a formal reference list and defers to an 'evidence 字段' that is not part of the HTML. Evidence accuracy: All three expected claims are supported with correct source attribution, and content hashes in the Source Trace match the frozen sources. However, a few statements go slightly beyond the sources: '大部分价值在固定 DAG 场景中未被使用' (Platform Comparison) is an inference from source_001, not stated; 'LangGraph ... 缺少高层 agent 便利性' is an unattributed evaluative judgment; '可提升逐节点模型选择结果的可靠性' extends source_003's typed-output claim; and 'LangGraph 的显式节点与边更利于基准测试的逐节点评分与关键路径延迟测量' in Risks is a synthesized claim not directly in any source. Analysis depth: The report compares four platforms against fixed-DAG constraints, ties selection criteria to the research question, and the Risks section identifies concrete trade-offs (over-abstraction, boundary violations, premature dynamic re-splitting). Depth is solid but comparative analysis remains qualitative with no scoring matrix or quantitative comparison, and some risk reasoning relies on inference rather than source-grounded evidence. Structure and readability: Clear section hierarchy, logical flow from background to criteria to comparison to risks to conclusion, consistent citation style, readable Chinese prose. HTML validity: Well-formed HTML with DOCTYPE, proper nesting, matching ids for all citation anchors, and correct data-content-hash values; minor issues include lack of lang-appropriate meta viewport and the References section's reliance on an external 'evidence 字段' not present in the document.
